name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1901: The Chronicle is read by two lanes so that agreement between them is evidence, and for eleven versions the two lanes were not looking at the same pixels - the claude lane has cropped to the list band since v1780, measured 0 of 6 pages full frame against 5 of 6 cropped, while the grok lane was handed the whole 2940x1912 desktop grab every time because the crop lived inside the claude reader where no other lane could call it. Agreement between witnesses shown different pictures is worth less than it reads, and a disagreement was not even attributable because the framing was never written down. One crop now, called by both, with the same refused-crop-retries-the-full-frame route, and every page stamps which pixels its witness actually saw. This does not claim the crop is better - v1829 measured the opposite on one frame and that tension is recorded rather than resolved.
